body:
- This does not implement the change where calling `showModal()` on `<dialog autofocus>` will cause the dialog itself to get focus. Probably the best way to spec that is to change the `showModal()` spec to check for the autofocus attribute and, if present, focus the dialog instead of going into the focus delegate steps.

- A big part of the proposal was writing up https://github.com/whatwg/html/wiki/dialog--initial-focus,-a-proposal#improving-conformance-requirements-and-examples as spec text, to replace the current single sentence "The [dialog](https://whatpr.org/html/8199/interactive-elements.html#the-dialog-element) element represents a part of an application that a user interacts with to perform a task, for example a dialog box, inspector, or window."

Sorry again for the big delay.

This is still blocked on https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/8174 I think, as I'd prefer to have the focus delegate algorithm be correct before we started modifying it. IIRC the latest was @emilio was going to work on ensuring we had test coverage for the cases there.

LGTM with two nits plus the block on https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/8174. Once that is merged I can try to take care of the rebasing.

I guess we also need tests...
Looks good editorially, found a couple nits.
Thanks! Looks good modulo tiny nit. Still not entirely happy about the example, but cannot think of something better and this at least avoids the readonly problem.

Normative parts LGTM. I have a quibble about the example, but everyone should consider this ready to implement.

It would be good to get explicit reaffirmation from other implementers that they are still on-board with this plan. I guess we can tag this with agenda+, and remove that if they respond to the standards positions request before the next meeting.
